description: Centralized database schema configuration for FlightCheckPy

vw_discontinuous_hbnb.description: 缺失的HBNB号码（不连续的号码）- 计算min和max之间缺失的号码
vw_discontinuous_hbnb.sql: WITH all_hbnb AS (SELECT hbnb_number FROM hbpr_full_records UNION SELECT hbnb_number FROM hbpr_simple_records), hbnb_range AS (SELECT MIN(hbnb_number) as min_num, MAX(hbnb_number) as max_num FROM all_hbnb), number_series AS (WITH RECURSIVE nums(n) AS (SELECT (SELECT min_num FROM hbnb_range) UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM nums WHERE n < (SELECT max_num FROM hbnb_range)) SELECT n as hbnb_number FROM nums) SELECT ns.hbnb_number FROM number_series ns WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM all_hbnb ah WHERE ah.hbnb_number = ns.hbnb_number)

vw_home_accepted_counts.description: 已接受乘客统计（按舱位分类）
vw_home_accepted_counts.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_accepted, MIN(boarding_number) as min_boarding, MAX(boarding_number) as max_boarding, AVG(bag_piece) as avg_bag_piece, AVG(bag_weight) as avg_bag_weight, SUM(bag_piece) as total_bag_pieces, SUM(bag_weight) as total_bag_weight, SUM(CASE WHEN has_infant = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as infant_count, SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as accepted_first, SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as accepted_business, SUM(CASE WHEN class = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as accepted_economy FROM hbpr_full_records WHERE boarding_number IS NOT NULL AND boarding_number > 0

vw_home_flags.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_deleted, SUM(CASE WHEN properties LIKE '%XRES%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as deleted_with_xres, SUM(CASE WHEN (properties NOT LIKE '%XRES%' OR properties IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as deleted_without_xres FROM hbpr_full_records WHERE is_deleted >= 1

vw_deleted_boarding_numbers.description: 删除乘客的登机号列表
vw_deleted_boarding_numbers.sql: SELECT is_deleted as boarding_number, CASE WHEN properties LIKE '%XRES%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_xres FROM hbpr_full_records WHERE is_deleted >= 1 ORDER BY is_deleted

vw_hbnb_range.sql: WITH all_hbnb AS (SELECT hbnb_number FROM hbpr_full_records UNION SELECT hbnb_number FROM hbpr_simple_records) SELECT MIN(hbnb_number) as min_hbnb, MAX(hbnb_number) as max_hbnb, COUNT(*) as total_found, (MAX(hbnb_number) - MIN(hbnb_number) + 1) as total_expected FROM all_hbnb

vw_missing_boarding_numbers.description: 缺失的登机号（排除已删除乘客）
vw_missing_boarding_numbers.sql: WITH boarding_range AS (SELECT MIN(boarding_number) as min_bn, MAX(boarding_number) as max_bn FROM hbpr_full_records WHERE boarding_number IS NOT NULL AND boarding_number > 0), number_series AS (WITH RECURSIVE nums(n) AS (SELECT (SELECT min_bn FROM boarding_range) UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM nums WHERE n < (SELECT max_bn FROM boarding_range)) SELECT n as boarding_number FROM nums WHERE n IS NOT NULL), existing_boarding AS (SELECT DISTINCT boarding_number FROM hbpr_full_records WHERE boarding_number IS NOT NULL AND boarding_number > 0), deleted_boarding AS (SELECT is_deleted as boarding_number FROM hbpr_full_records WHERE is_deleted >= 1) SELECT ns.boarding_number FROM number_series ns WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_boarding eb WHERE eb.boarding_number = ns.boarding_number) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deleted_boarding db WHERE db.boarding_number = ns.boarding_number) ORDER BY ns.boarding_number

vw_duplicate_seats.description: 重复的座位号及对应的乘客姓名（仅统计非XRES乘客）
vw_duplicate_seats.sql: SELECT seat, GROUP_CONCAT(name, ',') as names, COUNT(*) as count FROM (SELECT seat, name FROM hbpr_full_records WHERE properties IS NOT NULL AND properties != '' AND properties NOT LIKE '%XRES%' AND seat IS NOT NULL AND seat != '') GROUP BY seat HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY seat

vw_duplicate_names.description: 重复的乘客姓名（去除后缀后）及对应的座位号和登机号
vw_duplicate_names.sql: WITH cleaned_names AS (SELECT hbnb_number, boarding_number, seat, TRIM(CASE WHEN name LIKE '%MR' THEN SUBSTR(name, 1, LENGTH(name)-2) WHEN name LIKE '%MS' THEN SUBSTR(name, 1, LENGTH(name)-2) WHEN name LIKE '%MRS' THEN SUBSTR(name, 1, LENGTH(name)-3) WHEN name LIKE '%MSTR' THEN SUBSTR(name, 1, LENGTH(name)-4) WHEN name LIKE '%PHD' THEN SUBSTR(name, 1, LENGTH(name)-3) WHEN name LIKE '%CHD' THEN SUBSTR(name, 1, LENGTH(name)-3) WHEN name LIKE '%INF' THEN SUBSTR(name, 1, LENGTH(name)-3) WHEN name LIKE '%VIP' THEN SUBSTR(name, 1, LENGTH(name)-3) ELSE name END) as cleaned_name FROM hbpr_full_records WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND name != '' AND properties NOT LIKE '%XRES%') SELECT cleaned_name, GROUP_CONCAT(boarding_number, ',') as boarding_numbers, GROUP_CONCAT(seat, ',') as seats, COUNT(*) as count FROM cleaned_names WHERE cleaned_name != '' GROUP BY cleaned_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY count DESC, cleaned_name

vw_asvc_seat_mismatches.description: ASVC座位与seat列不匹配的乘客（asvc_seat从ASVC消息中正确提取）
vw_asvc_seat_mismatches.sql: SELECT DISTINCT hbnb_number, name FROM hbpr_full_records WHERE asvc_seat IS NOT NULL AND asvc_seat != '' AND (seat IS NULL OR seat = '' OR seat != asvc_seat) AND (properties IS NULL OR properties NOT LIKE '%XRES%') ORDER BY name
